verdict.rationale: Pendo's analytics page says users can track and compare navigation paths to spot drop-off and boost conversion, and the session replay page mentions clicking a funnel drop-off to watch the sessions behind it, so a funnel feature for finding drop-off appears to exist. The segment, account and plan filtering in the evidence describes session replay only, not funnels. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-step funnel building, funnel-level filters, breakdowns/segmentation of funnel results, independent or hands-on corroboration.
